chunks: And he asked him about anklets: is it proper for women and children to wear them? He said:
“If they are silent, there is no harm; but if they have a sound, then it is not proper.”
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for women and children to wear anklets that make sound?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the wearing of anklets by women and children. It permits wearing anklets when they do not produce a sound, while disapproving them when they make noise.
